# Feature Specifications

This directory contains PRDs (Product Requirements Documents) and Tech Specs for
features in development.

## File Naming Convention

| Document Type | Pattern             | Example               |
| ------------- | ------------------- | --------------------- |
| PRD           | `prd-[feature].md`  | `prd-puzzle-mode.md`  |
| Tech Spec     | `tech-[feature].md` | `tech-puzzle-mode.md` |

## Templates

- PRD Template: [../process/PRD_TEMPLATE.md](../process/PRD_TEMPLATE.md)
- Tech Spec Template:
  [../process/TECH_SPEC_TEMPLATE.md](../process/TECH_SPEC_TEMPLATE.md)

## Workflow

1. Copy the appropriate template
2. Rename following the convention above
3. Fill out all sections
4. Update status as document progresses through review

## Document Lifecycle

```text
Draft → In Review → Approved → Implemented
```

Once a feature is fully implemented and released, the spec may be archived or
kept for reference.
